name: The Watch at Dusk
image_style: Cinematic historical fantasy illustration with finely textured gouache, ink-wash atmosphere, and restrained illuminated-manuscript detailing. Quietly reverent medieval realism, weathered stone, wool, leather, banners, and steel rendered with tactile precision; broad atmospheric perspective and soft dusk haze. Palette of deep midnight blue, charcoal, old ivory, muted crimson, tarnished gold, and cold moonlit silver. Understated affectionate humor comes from Space Ghost’s solemn, conspicuously misplaced presence, never from the sacred setting. Spacious composition with a calm, low-contrast upper edge and an uncluttered widget-friendly region; no lettering, logos, watermarks, frames, or interface elements.
scene: A wide 16:10 view of a windswept Crusader-era hilltop fortress at blue hour, its chapel and battlements rendered with historical accuracy and quiet reverence beneath a broad, nearly empty twilight sky. In the lower-right courtyard, Levi Ackerman stands composed beside a stone parapet, inspecting a rain-darkened sword and folded field map with disciplined calm. A few respectful knights prepare horses in the middle distance. At the far left, half-hidden behind a crenellation, Space Ghost makes an unmistakably earnest reconnaissance pose: muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape hanging stiffly in the wind, and red power bands visible at his wrists. He is clearly an out-of-place visitor taking the military occasion completely seriously, while no one treats him as holy or venerates him. Keep the upper third quiet and atmospheric, with the strongest detail concentrated along the lower horizon and side figures; no text or lettering.
source_phrase: Levi from Attack on Titan with Spaceghost
